response:
A few things to check — the fan won’t blow just because it’s sitting next to an outlet:

1) You have to run the level. Devices only operate in Play mode, not while you’re still editing.

3) Make sure the fan’s plug is actually plugged into the outlet (the plug must touch/snap into the outlet).  
4) Also verify nothing solid is blocking the fan’s front so the airflow can’t escape.
